summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear largely implemented via updated monthly total computation helpers in habitModel and a new MonthlyVolumeSummary component rendered in BecomingView. However, the aggregate summary UI conditionally hides categories instead of showing 0/0:00 when a category is absent, which conflicts with REQ-2 acceptance criteria. Several additional, unrelated behavior changes (auth/error/loading prioritization, query behavior changes) are present in the diff summary but were not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: If no habits exist for a category (e.g., no time habits), the aggregate summary displays 0 (or 0:00 for time) for that category.
missing_requirements.reason: MonthlyVolumeSummary only renders a category block when `hasReps`/`hasTime`/`hasNumeric` is true; if a category has no habits it is omitted rather than displayed as 0/0:00.

hallucinated_features.description: Changed BecomingView behavior to prioritize error states over loading states and added/altered auth gating and skeleton rendering logic beyond adding the monthly volume summary.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1/REQ-2 only request volume calculation fixes and an aggregate summary; they do not request changes to authentication/error/loading state handling.

hallucinated_features.description: React Query behavior changes including principal-scoped query keys, immutable optimistic updates for completion toggles, and actor initialization error normalization.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-1/REQ-2 and could be considered scope expansion beyond volume total calculations and the new summary.
